name: infocyph/foundation
description: Performance-first application foundation for the Infocyph PHP ecosystem.

suggest.infocyph/cachelayer: Adds cache stores, native bulk paths, optional atomic claim/consume/CAS, locks, counters, node/cluster cache, and shared authentication/runtime state.
suggest.infocyph/dblayer: Adds database services, persistence, migrations, query caching, replicas, and MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL/SQLite/SQL Server support.
suggest.infocyph/epicrypt: Adds cryptography, secrets, password, token, and key security services.
suggest.infocyph/omnibus: Adds events, messages, durable queues, handler middleware, workers, optional process pools, retries, workflows, and scheduled-message dispatch.
suggest.infocyph/otp: Adds OTP-backed multi-factor authentication and Passkey/WebAuthn ceremony integration with CacheLayer-backed replay-safe state.
suggest.infocyph/pathwise: Adds filesystem, storage, upload, download, archive, sync, retention, and storage capability enforcement.
suggest.infocyph/reqshield: Adds request, command, configuration, schema, sanitization, typed input, and database validation services.
suggest.infocyph/talkingbytes: Adds HTTP, inbound/outbound email, webhook, and gRPC communication services.
suggest.web-auth/webauthn-lib: Required by OTP Passkey when the WebAuthn passkey driver is selected.
